title: discover_agents result
description: What discover_agents hands back to the model (docs/agent-tools.md, section 2): one entry per address. The running instances of one agent share an address and appear once, with `instances` counting them. An extension may add fields to an entry (docs/agent-tools.md, section 6.3).

address.description: the agent's prompt subject, `agents.prompt.<agent>.<owner>.<name>`; the argument prompt_agent takes. Protocol §3.4: every instance of the agent shares it

agent.description: the kind of agent, as it registered itself (for example `researcher`, `claude-code`)

owner.description: who runs it, as it registered itself

name.description: the instance name that tells several agents of one kind and owner apart

description.description: what the agent says it does; may be empty

identity.description: the agent ID the agent registered, `<account>.<user>` (protocol §13.3); null when it registered none

identity_verified.description: true when the registration carries a signature that verifies over the address (protocol §13.10)

requires_signed_prompts.description: true when the agent refuses prompts its caller has not signed (protocol §13.9)

accepts_attachments.description: true when prompt_agent may send files along (protocol §2.1, `attachments_ok`)

instances.description: how many running instances answer at this address

open_calls.description: how many calls in the current scope are still open (running or input_required); absent when none is

open_calls_note.description: the same, in words, with what happens to them
